howto: Pick a tour stop on the map or the event cards.
Press START EVENT, then choose how your heat went: wipeout, bronze, silver or gold.
Bronze or better unlocks the next stop and earns XP, tour points and credits.
Climb the rankings and sponsor tiers across all seven stops to the Tidebreak Finals.
tips: Gold pays the full XP and tour points; bronze pays 70% and silver 88%.
Replaying a stop only pays again when you beat your medal there.
Tour points move you up the world rankings on the right.
Each stop has a target score; its card shows the surf size and conditions.
Your tour saves after every event.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys move between stops and buttons, Enter confirms, Esc closes the result dialog.
controls.touch: Tap a stop or card, then tap START EVENT and a result.
controls.gamepad: D-pad to move, A to confirm, B to go back

difficulty: Seven stops in order with rising target scores; each one opens only after a bronze at the stop before it.

cheats.effect: Your next event counts as a gold-medal heat

features.tutorial: Three coach steps on the first visit (pick a stop, start the event, choose a result) with Skip; Replay tutorial in the arcade menu runs it again
features.results: A result card after each event: score, medal, XP and tour points, and any stop it unlocked
features.restart: Restart opens the selected event again
features.hints: The arcade Hint names the next stop and the score it needs for bronze
features.codes-on: Using a code marks the tour CODES ON (top right) and a result with codes on never sets a best score
features.reduced-motion: Follows the browser's reduced-motion setting (the event dialog appears without its fade)
